signer.description: Account adding liquidity; must be majority owner of pool shares.

amounts.description: Amounts to add: exactly two coins matching pool denoms; > 0. Canonicalized to pool denom order. Full amounts are escrowed; surplus is refunded (band mode refunds to match ΔL; v2 refunds to match minted shares).

cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.title: Coin
